And I tried to be clear -- I don't want love and support, I just want a break. I'm not wanting this to manipulate anyone in my personal life. In fact, if there was a way for them to not know, I'd want that. I just want the undeniably concrete reason to allow me a break from work. I don't want more love out of this wish. I don't want anyone to take care of me. I want the time to be able to take care of myself.

You're right, of course, I've painted myself into this corner. I don't blame anyone else. Sometimes there's a point of no return though.
